commitsBeforeThisRecord.purpose: Add the initial canonical ReflectionProbe state validator/fingerprint.
Add the machine-readable two-probe state coherence contract.
Self-audit correction: import UnityEngine.Rendering for ReflectionProbeClearFlags.
Advance the reflection lighting fingerprint to v4 and fold in the validated probe-state SHA-256.
Bind the new probe-state contract into the existing core Visual Gate integrity dependency path.
Self-audit correction: retain fallback background color in the fingerprint but stop requiring canonical black when Skybox clear makes the RGB irrelevant.
Align the machine-readable contract with the corrected Skybox fallback-background policy.
Refresh Implementation Readiness while keeping Visual Fidelity unscored.

problemFound.summary: Realtime reflection cubemaps were freshness-checked and bound to sun/sky/ambient/material/renderer state, but the ReflectionProbe configuration itself was not identity-bound across request, async polling, completion and the following still.
previouslyUnboundState: near/far clipping and probe shadow distance
realtime mode, refresh mode and time-slicing policy
problemFound.risk: A recently completed cubemap could still represent a different local reflection field from the still. That can make metal, glass and wet/dielectric response appear plausible while the evidence no longer corresponds to the authored physical scene.

changes: Added QualityBlockReflectionProbeStateCoherenceQA.cs with exact canonical authoring checks for the two benchmark probes and a deterministic reflection-probe-state-v1 SHA-256.

Added reflection_probe_state_coherence_contract.json. It machine-locks the two authored probe identities, positions, influence/capture volumes, blend, box projection, resolution/HDR, intensity/importance, clipping/shadow distance, all-layer culling, Skybox clear and realtime refresh policy.

Folded the validated probe-state digest into QualityBlockReflectionLightingStateFingerprint, advancing the outer schema marker to reflection-lighting-state-v4. The existing async waiter therefore compares probe configuration at request, every observed Editor poll, completion and immediate pre-still validation without creating a second timing path.

Bound the probe-state contract into QualityBlockReflectionMaterialPhysicalityBindingQA.ValidateContractConfigOnly, which is already called by QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA, so source-side core gate validation also rejects a weakened probe configuration contract.

Self-audited Unity 6 API usage against current ReflectionProbe documentation. Added the required UnityEngine.Rendering namespace. A second audit found that Unity's fallback background color is not physically relevant while clearFlags=Skybox and the physical skybox is mandatory, so the code now requires only a finite fallback value and fingerprints it for temporal drift rather than falsely requiring black.
Updated implementation_readiness.json while keeping the score at 93/100 and Visual Fidelity unscored.

verification.note: No Unity runner is available. Source/API review establishes fail-closed intent and contract wiring only; it cannot prove compilation, realtime reflection behavior or rendered image quality.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.impact: Fresh reflection evidence must now use the exact authored local probe placement/capture/influence/clipping/culling/intensity state throughout synchronization.
Angular/Fresnel and highlight review is less vulnerable to a cubemap captured from a different position, volume or intensity than the still's actual local reflection field.
Highlight/exposure review cannot silently rely on a differently configured local reflection environment after the probe refresh.
Reduces evidence risk around impossible_material_physics, sun_shadow_inconsistency and unverified_render_claim; no critical defect is auto-cleared.

limitations: No actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile was available, so source/API compatibility remains runtime verification pending.
The fingerprint proves configuration identity, not that the cubemap pixels are visually convincing or free from engine/rendering defects.
Fallback background RGB is intentionally not fixed while Skybox clear and the physical skybox are mandatory; its finite value is still fingerprinted to detect unexplained temporal mutation.
No 3840x2160 benchmark stills, 100% crops or temporal sequences were produced; Visual Fidelity remains unscored.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner. On first availability, stop speculative expansion and run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. Confirm reflection-lighting-state-v4, including nested reflection-probe-state-v1, remains identical from pre-RenderProbe request through every observed Editor poll, completion and immediate pre-still validation. Then review only sealed native hero/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 pixels and 100% crops for scoring.
